name: Kurui Kurutte Kuruwasete ~Encore~
source:
Kuuya and Kairi have known each other since they were kids. They're currently dating, but Kairi has been having sex with a bunch of guys other than Kuuya. Add to that the self-harm and repeated suicide attempts and you'll see that Kairi is not right in the head.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ335556.html]DLsite[/url]]

Kuuya和Kairi从小就认识，如今两人正在交往，但Kairi一直和许多其他男人发生关系。再加上自残和反复自杀未遂，你就能看出Kairi的精神状态并不正常。
